summary.en: Fever of 103 for four days with body pain and pain behind the eyes; dengue to be ruled out. Stop Combiflam, take Dolo 650 three times a day after food for three days. Dengue NS1 and CBC today, at least three litres of fluids a day, return tomorrow with reports or at once if gums bleed or stools turn black.

follow_up.reason: review with dengue and CBC reports

instructions.text: Drink at least three litres of fluids a day
Come immediately if gums bleed or stools are black

open_questions: Electral: how often and for how many days?
